scope: Integrated path models relating computational thinking and STEM attitudes to computational self-efficacy, scientific problem solving, and scientific reasoning, with cautious multi-group comparison across gender.
interpretation_boundary: No viable temporal positive holdout exists. Report descriptive frozen-group coverage and stability only; do not infer causal or confirmed path-specific gender differences.
legacy_group_key_note: The runner reads kbs_frozen_evidence_groups; these are independently frozen C6 groups.
